#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

inline char gc() {
    static char buf[1000000], *p1 = buf, *p2 = buf;
    return p1 == p2 && (p2 = (p1 = buf) + fread(buf, 1, 1000000, stdin), p1 == p2) ? EOF : *p1++;
}

ll read() {
    ll pos = 1, num = 0;
    char ch = gc();
    while (!isdigit(ch)) {
        if (ch == '-') pos = -1;
        ch = gc();
    }
    while (isdigit(ch)) {
        num = num * 10 + (ch - '0');
        ch = gc();
    }
    return pos * num;
}

void write(ll x) {
    if (x < 0) {
        putchar('-');
        write(-x);
        return;
    }
    if (x >= 10) write(x / 10);
    putchar(x % 10 + '0');
}

void writeln(ll x) {
    write(x);
    putchar('\n');
}

const ll MOD1 = 998244353, MOD2 = 1000000007;
vector<ll> vals[7];
ll n, counter1, counter2, total, powers[7] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

bool is_valid(ll x) {
    return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && x * 10000000 > n;
}

void dfs1(ll depth, ll current) {
    if (depth == 7) return;
    vals[depth].push_back((counter1 - current % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
    total = (total + vals[depth].back()) % MOD1;
    counter1++;
    for (ll digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit)
        dfs1(depth + 1, current * 10 + digit);
}

void dfs2(ll depth, ll current) {
    if (current > n) return;
    if (is_valid(current)) {
        for (ll d = 0; d <= 6; ++d) {
            ll needed = ((counter2 + 1 - current * powers[d]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            auto it = lower_bound(vals[d].begin(), vals[d].end(), needed);
            ll idx = it - vals[d].begin();
            ll contrib = (total + needed * (ll)vals[d].size() - MOD1 * (ll)(vals[d].size() - idx)) % MOD2;
            total = (total + contrib) % MOD2;
        }
        counter2 += counter1;
    } else {
        counter2++;
        total = (total + ((counter2 - current) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD2) % MOD2;
        for (ll digit = (depth == 0); digit <= 9; ++digit)
            dfs2(depth + 1, current * 10 + digit);
    }
}

int main() {
    n = read();
    dfs1(0, 0);
    for (ll i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) sort(vals[i].begin(), vals[i].end());
    counter2 = -1;
    dfs2(0, 0);
    writeln((total % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2);
}

vector<ll> bucket[7];

inline char getc() {
    static char buf[1000000], *p1 = buf, *p2 = buf;
    return p1 == p2 && (p2 = (p1 = buf) + fread(buf, 1, 1000000, stdin), p1 == p2) ? EOF : *p1++;

ll input() {
    ll x = 0, f = 1;
    char c = getc();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') f = -1; c = getc(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = x * 10 + c - '0'; c = getc(); }
    return x * f;
}

void output(ll x) {
    if (x < 0) { putchar('-'); output(-x); return; }
    if (x > 9) output(x / 10);
    putchar(x % 10 + '0');
}

void print(ll x) { output(x); putchar('\n'); }

bool valid(ll x) {
    return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && x * 10000000 > n;
}

void precompute(ll d, ll num) {
    if (d == 7) return;
    ll val = (cnt1 - num % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
    bucket[d].push_back(val);
    cnt1++;
    for (ll i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) precompute(d + 1, num * 10 + i);
}

void solve(ll d, ll num) {
    if (num > n) return;
    if (valid(num)) {
        for (ll i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            ll target = ((cnt2 + 1 - num * pow10[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            auto lb = lower_bound(bucket[i].begin(), bucket[i].end(), target);
            ll idx = lb - bucket[i].begin();
            ll sz = bucket[i].size();
            ll sum_part = 0;
            for (ll j = idx; j < sz; ++j) sum_part = (sum_part + bucket[i][j]) % MOD2;
            ans = (ans + (sum_part + target * (sz - idx) % MOD2) % MOD2) % MOD2;
        }
        cnt2 += cnt1;
    } else {
        cnt2++;
        ans = (ans + ((cnt2 - num) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD2) % MOD2;
        for (ll i = (d == 0); i <= 9; ++i) solve(d + 1, num * 10 + i);
    }
}

int main() {
    n = input();
    precompute(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) sort(bucket[i].begin(), bucket[i].end());
    cnt2 = -1;
    solve(0, 0);
    print(ans);
